shortBio: An academic, researcher, and information systems practitioner specializing in IT integration, computer network infrastructure, enterprise systems architecture, business process transformation, and modern software engineering.
fullBio: Agus Sifaunajah (widely recognized as MAS-AGUS) is an academic, researcher, and professional in Information Systems, Computing Technology, and Network Infrastructure. Combining academic rigor with practical software and network engineering, he is dedicated to advancing digital literacy and applied technological research.

Through MAS-AGUS Knowledge Hub, he shares in-depth technical insights covering enterprise systems architecture, computer network infrastructure, digital transformation strategies for public institutions and SMEs, and applied research methodologies in computing.

Alongside lecturing and academic research, he holds technical competencies in computer networking (particularly MikroTik RouterOS engineering and dynamic routing), modern Jamstack/static web architectures, scientific digital publishing, and practical computing solutions for enterprise challenges.

expertise.title: Computer Networks & Infrastructure
expertise.description: Network topology design, dynamic and static routing, bandwidth management & QoS, IPv6 protocol deployment, network security hardening, and MikroTik RouterOS engineering.

expertise.title: Information Systems & Enterprise Architecture
expertise.description: Integrated information systems architecture design, business requirements engineering, and enterprise system workflow modeling.

expertise.title: Digital Transformation & Governance
expertise.description: Legacy system migration strategies to digital ecosystems, IT governance frameworks, and organizational digital readiness assessment.

expertise.title: Modern Software Engineering
expertise.description: High-performance Jamstack/SSG web development, TypeScript, RESTful API architecture, multi-tenant database modeling, and CI/CD automation.

expertise.title: Research Methodology & Scientific Publishing
expertise.description: Applied computing research (DSRM, SEM-PLS), academic paper writing, and scholarly Open Journal Systems (OJS) editorial governance.

certifications.name: MikroTik Certified Network Associate
certifications.note: Previously certified and currently undergoing recertification
certifications.description: Computer networking fundamentals, MikroTik RouterOS architecture, bandwidth management (Simple Queues & Queue Tree), firewall filter & NAT, wireless, VPN tunnels, and network troubleshooting.

certifications.name: MikroTik Certified Routing Engineer
certifications.note: Previously certified and currently undergoing recertification
certifications.description: Advanced static routing, dynamic routing protocols (OSPF), point-to-point tunneling (IPIP, EoIP, GRE), VLAN implementation, and multi-gateway routing architecture.

certifications.name: MikroTik Certified IPv6 Engineer
certifications.note: Previously certified and currently undergoing recertification
certifications.description: IPv6 protocol packet architecture, IPv6 addressing and subnetting, automatic address configuration (SLAAC & DHCPv6), IPv6 security mechanisms, and transition tunneling.
